description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Rograkh.
Rograkh dies, triggering Koll, returning Rograkh from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Rograkh by paying {0}.
Rograkh enters the battlefield, triggering Hero's Blade, attaching Hero's Blade to Rograkh.
Repeat.
